post.description: You have a barcode (or a world.openfoodfacts.org product URL) and want its nutrition facts, ingredients, allergens or scores. Use `search` first when you only know a name or brand.

barcode.description: Product barcode: GTIN-8/12/13/14 (EAN, UPC) as digits, leading zeros kept. Open Food Facts normalises codes, so the returned `barcode` may carry extra leading zeros. Exactly one of `barcode` or `url`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{8,14}$.

country.description: Two-letter country code (`cc`) the site uses for country-dependent computations such as the Nutri-Score comparison country; default `us`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

lang.description: Two-letter language code (`lc`) for localised names; default `en`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

url.description: A product page URL on any Open Food Facts country site, e.g. https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/5449000000996/coca-cola or https://fr.openfoodfacts.org/produit/5449000000996. The barcode is taken from the path.

200.description:
One packaged food product by barcode (GTIN/EAN/UPC) from Open Food Facts: names, brand, quantity and serving, selling countries, categories, labels, stores, ingredients (text and parsed list with percent estimates and vegan/vegetarian flags), allergens, traces, additives, ingredient analysis, Nutri-Score (grade, score, version), NOVA group, Eco-Score, nutrient levels, the raw nutriments table (per 100 g and per serving, site keys), a fixed per-100g summary, image URLs, edit timestamps, the canonical product URL and the ODbL attribution.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: Find products by name, brand or category, e.g. 'oat milk' sold in France, then call `product` with a hit's barcode for the full record. Use `suggest` to turn a typed category or brand into the taxonomy id the filters expect.

brand.description: Brand tag (`coca-cola`, `oatly`); lower-case slug, `en:` prefix accepted and stripped.

category.description: Category taxonomy id (`en:oat-milks`) or bare slug (`oat-milks`); `suggest` returns these ids.

country.description: Selling country as a taxonomy id (`en:france`) or bare slug (`france`, `united-states`). Matched against `countries_tags`.

facets.description: When true, return facet counts for `brands_tags`, `nutrition_grades` and `countries_tags` (default false).

lang.description: Language the text is matched in and names are returned in; default `en`. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$.

page.description:
1-based page; the service refuses to page past 10000 hits, so page * page_size must stay within 10000.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

page_size.description:
Hits per page, default 24.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100.

query.description: Free text, e.g. `oat milk`. At least one of `query`, `country`, `category`, `brand`, `nutriscore_grade`, `nova_group` is required.

sort.description:
`relevance` (default; score order), `popularity` (unique scans, descending) or `recent` (last edit, descending).

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "popularity", "recent"].

200.description:
Search Open Food Facts products through the Search-a-licious service: free text (matched on product name, generic name, categories, labels and brands in `lang`) and/or structured filters (selling country, category, brand, Nutri-Score grade, NOVA group), sorted by relevance, popularity or last edit, paginated. Each hit carries barcode, product URL, name, brands, quantity, categories, countries, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, allergens, a per-100g nutrient summary, image URLs and the edit timestamp. Optional facet counts for brands, Nutri-Score grades and countries.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attribution` | object | Licence attribution the site requires: database ODbL, images CC BY-SA 3.0, with the source URL. |
| `count` | number | Matching products as the service reports it; capped at 10000 when `count_is_exact` is false. |
| `count_is_exact` | boolean |  |
| `facets` | object[] | Empty unless `facets` was requested. |
| `filters` | object |  |
| `hits` | object[] |  |
| `lang` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_count` | number | Pages available within the service's 10000-hit window; 0 when nothing matched. |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `query` | string | The free text sent, trimmed; null for a filter-only search. |
| `sort` | string |  |
